headers.title: Headers and constants
headers.text: The site as Referer on covers; COVER_ATTR the image attribute that held a real address; FRAME the element that holds the player on an episode page; KNOWN_HOSTS the embed hosts the extractor expects.

getPopular.title: Popular
getPopular.text: The home page's title links (/anime/… and poster cards), one page. A site with a /popular page can point this at it.

getLatest.title: Latest
getLatest.text: The home page's episode links folded back to their title, one page.

search.title: Search
search.text: /search?keyword=words; some sites use /search?q= or /?s= instead, which is a one-line change.

getDetails.title: Title page
getDetails.text: The h1 or og:title, og:image as cover, the description block or og:description, genre links.

getChapterList.title: Episodes
getChapterList.text: Every episode link of the title page, each address once, numbered from data-number, the text or the address, returned oldest first.

getVideoList.title: Videos
getVideoList.text: The episode page's player frames: a plain <source> is a direct file; an embed is loaded in the hidden browser and the .m3u8 / .mp4 it asks for is the video, with the embed page as Referer and every video under its server's group. A master playlist is split into one entry per quality. An unknown host is named in the console.

helpers.title: Helpers
helpers.text: One request with the site as Referer, the title-card parser, the embed extractor through the hidden browser, absolute addresses and the first number of a text.
